const int MOD = 998244353;

long long modInverse(long long a, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long exp = mod - 2;
    a %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    
    long long invMPlus1 = modInverse(m + 1, MOD);
    long long ans = (1 + invMPlus1 * n % MOD) % MOD;
    long long base = invMPlus1 * ((long long)m * (m + n + 1) % MOD) % MOD;
    long long harmonicSum = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        harmonicSum = (harmonicSum + modInverse(i, MOD)) % MOD;
    }
    
    ans = (base * harmonicSum % MOD + ans) % MOD;
    
    cout << ans << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
